overview_description.description: Rapyd is a financial technology company that provides infrastructure for global payments and embedded financial services through APIs. It enables businesses to accept payments, send payouts, and manage money movement using a single platform that connects multiple local and international payment methods. The company supports services such as card issuing, digital wallets, foreign exchange, and multi-currency accounts to help businesses operate across different markets. Its platform is used by companies in areas like e-commerce, marketplaces, online gaming, and digital services to simplify cross-border transactions and financial operations. Rapyd also integrates compliance, licensing, and payment processing capabilities so businesses can operate without building their own financial infrastructure.

about_short_description.short_description: Rapyd is a financial technology company that provides payment processing and fintech infrastructure for businesses.

product.name: Rapyd Global Payments Platform
product.description: A financial infrastructure platform that enables businesses to accept, send, hold and manage funds across countries, currencies and payment methods through a single integration.

product.name: Rapyd Collect
product.description: A payment acceptance service for online and in-person transactions using cards, bank transfers, e-wallets, cash and other local payment methods.

product.name: Rapyd Disburse
product.description: An API-driven global payout service for sending funds to contractors, employees, suppliers, sellers and customers through bank transfers, cards, e-wallets and other local methods.

product.name: Rapyd Card Acquiring
product.description: A card acquiring service for processing Visa, Mastercard and other card payments online and in stores, with local acquiring capabilities in supported markets.

product.name: Rapyd Issuing
product.description: A card-issuing service that lets businesses create and manage physical and virtual prepaid or commercial cards for payments, withdrawals and controlled spending.

product.name: Rapyd Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet and ledger infrastructure service for holding, transferring and managing funds in multiple currencies and supporting payments, payouts and card programs.
